commonCaptureProtocol.browser: Desktop Chromium-family browser with DevTools Network export available
beforeOpeningTarget: Disable cache while DevTools is open.
Clear Network immediately before each target so each HAR belongs to one game session.
duringCapture: Launch only the exact target listed.
Let game/state/jackpot UI finish loading without wagering.
If bet level can be changed without a wager, passive state inspection is allowed; never press Spin/Deal/Draw/Play.
export: Export one HAR with content per target.
Do not edit timestamps, bodies, URLs or ordering before local analysis.
